name: Marconi’s early wireless experiments
short_desc: The history of radio had many contributors, beginning with the scientific discovery of electromagnetic radiation (radio waves) in the late 1800s, followed by technological development of improved devices for producing and receiving transmissions.
date_note: This dates early Marconi experiments and patenting, not a sole invention of radio. Hertz, Tesla, Lodge, Popov and others made different contributions.
